LanguageData.LC_EntityCodexGizmoDesc: Click to open the Management Manual
LanguageData.LC_EntityCodexDesc: Confidential archive of Abnormalities, Tools, and Ordeals. Spend Individual PE-Boxes or advance Containment Observation & Suppression to unlock classified dossiers and unlock company-wide milestone bonuses.
LanguageData.LC_EntityCodexTip.ZAYIN: With little to no aggression, ZAYIN Abnormalities will cause the least harm to your Agents.\nTheir damage tends to be minuscule, and they may have a positive effect on the employees.
LanguageData.LC_EntityCodexTip.TETH: These Abnormalities can inflict varying degrees of injury to your employees.\nHowever, as long as your employees follow the proper managerial guidelines, they will not cause much damage.
LanguageData.LC_EntityCodexTip.HE:
Abnormalities of this class can easily kill a number of employees.
You will have to pay twice as much attention as you do for a ZAYIN or TETH.
If the situation goes wrong, several employees could be lost in bloodshed.
There’s no need to be concerned though; with your excellent management, they will be in control.
LanguageData.LC_EntityCodexTip.WAW: These are high risk and carry devastating force.\nMost will be hostile toward employees, and the death toll could reach into the dozens.
LanguageData.LC_EntityCodexTip.ALEPH: The most dangerous. You should devote as much concentration and attention as possible to this Risk Level.\nYou’ll be thankful if the Abnormality is suppressed without ravaging entire departments.

LanguageData.LC_Codex_NoEntrySelected: Select an archive entry on the right to inspect its dossier.
LanguageData.LC_Codex_WorkMatrixUnavailable: Work preference parameters are managed by a specialized containment protocol.
LanguageData.LC_Codex_LockedBasicHint: True name and overview classified. Spend Individual PE-Boxes below or reach Observation Lv.1 to unlock.
LanguageData.LC_Codex_LockedWorkHint: Instinct / Insight / Attachment / Repression success matrix classified. Unlock via PE-Boxes or Observation Lv.2.
LanguageData.LC_Codex_LockedCombatHint: Four-color resistances and breach attack profile classified. Unlock via PE-Boxes or full Observation study.
LanguageData.LC_Codex_LockedTipsHint: Managerial guidelines and warnings classified. Unlock via PE-Boxes or Observation Lv.3.
LanguageData.LC_Codex_LockedToolLogsHint: Continue operating this Tool Abnormality on a containment platform to unlock its managerial logs.
LanguageData.LC_Codex_LockedOrdealCombatHint: Suppress at least 1 manifestation of this Ordeal to record its four-color resistances and attack profile.
LanguageData.LC_Codex_UnlockNotApplicable: This intel module is not applicable to the selected entry.
LanguageData.LC_Codex_NoStudyNotes: No observation logs unlocked yet. Conduct work on a containment platform to reveal details.
